detail: ch13 fits a Poisson disease-mapping model (gllamm o, i(county) offset(lne)) but the table has 56 rows, one per Scottish county (o observed, e expected cases): county is an observation-level random effect, not a grouping factor (melanoma/#24 convention).
Wide repeated-measures: one row per subject (subj), depression scores dep1-dep6 the six occasions in columns; the grouping unit (occasion) is no column of the table (#23 wide rule).

ch14 expands this one-row-per-academic table (id unique, 301 rows) into person-year records for a discrete-time survival logit; the loaded table itself is single-spell (dur, event) with no clustering column.

ch7 fits mixed read grade || id: grade after reshaping to long, but the loaded table is wide: one row per student (id), read0-read3/math0-math3/age0-age3 the four occasions in columns (#23 wide rule).
Single-spell recidivism duration (durat, cens), one row per released inmate (1445 rows); no clustering column to index random effects.
Wide repeated-measures: one row per patient (id), score1-score4 the four post-op occasions in columns; the grouping unit is no column (#23 wide rule).

Wide repeated-measures: one row per patient, respiratory status v1-v4 the four visits in columns (bl the baseline); the occasion grouping is no column (#23 wide rule). center clusters patients but the repeated response is spread across columns.
Map boundary coordinates (lon, lat) of 1515 polygon vertices for the Scottish lip-cancer regions (regcode/regid); a geographic layout, not grouped observations (coordinate rule, #22/#23).
56-row region-level summary of the lips lip-cancer analysis: observed cases with crude and model-predicted SMRs (smr_normal, smr_npml are fitted values). A derived results table, one row per region.
Single-spell survival of teacher tenure (t, censor), one row per teacher (id unique, 3941 rows); no clustering column.
ch12 fits mlogit alt Hinc Psize: one row per traveler (210 rows), alt the chosen mode; a cross-sectional multinomial with no repeated grouping (the long version is travel2).
Wide/aggregated twin data: twin1 and twin2 hold the two members' values in columns with a frequency count (num2) and zygosity (dzmz); no long grouping column for the pair.
ch10 fits logit workstat husbinc i.chilpres (Fox women's labour-force data): one row per wife (263 rows), a single cross-section with no clustering column; region is a fixed locality.
